tools.name: create_startup
tools.description: Create a new startup on BetaFinds (submitted for review). Upload the logo and screenshots first via upload_image (or POST https://betafinds.com/api/v1/images) and pass the returned URLs here. Set the category by slug — get the list via list_categories (a category name also works, case-insensitive).

tools.name: update_startup
tools.description: Update an existing startup: app-store links, website, short/full description, tags, category, logo and screenshots. Upload the logo and screenshots first via upload_image and pass the returned URLs (screenshots fully replace the current set; to clear the logo, pass an empty string). Pass only the fi

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List of available categories (slug and name) for create_startup.

tools.name: upload_image
tools.description: Upload an image (logo or screenshot) for create_startup. Pass the file content as base64 (data is base64 only, no data: prefix). Returns a url to pass into create_startup. Max 2 MB; formats: JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF.

tools.name: list_my_startups
tools.description: List of your startups on BetaFinds (slug, name, status). Updates can only be published for startups with APPROVED status.

tools.name: publish_update
tools.description: Publish an update (an entry in the «What's new» feed) for your startup. Subscribers receive an email summary within ~10 minutes. body supports Markdown.

tools.name: create_release
tools.description: Create a release (version) of your startup. By default also publishes a RELEASE-type update with the notes text. After creation, upload files via request_asset_upload.

tools.name: request_asset_upload
tools.description: Get a one-time link to upload a release file (Windows/Mac/Android/Linux, up to 1 GB). Then upload the file: curl -T <file> '<upload_url>'. After uploading, call complete_asset_upload.

tools.name: complete_asset_upload
tools.description: Confirm that the release file has been uploaded. Verifies the file's presence and size in storage and makes it available for download.

tools.name: get_releases
tools.description: Список опубликованных релизов стартапа с файлами. Для LAUNCHED-проектов downloadUrl — постоянная прямая ссылка. На закрытых стадиях ссылка возвращается только для своих стартапов или где у вас открыт доступ (иначе locked=true, downloadUrl=null).

tools.name: change_startup_stage
tools.description: Change your startup's product stage: PRELAUNCH — preparing to launch, BETA — recruiting beta testers, PAUSED — development paused (requires public_note). To move to LAUNCHED use announce_launch. Allowed transitions: PRELAUNCH→BETA/PAUSED, BETA→PAUSED, PAUSED→PRELAUNCH/BETA.

tools.name: announce_launch
tools.description: Announce your startup's official launch: the stage becomes LAUNCHED, a LAUNCH update is published, and waitlist members are notified (once). A working product link is required (url or an already saved store link).

tools.name: get_waitlist
tools.description: Waitlist summary for your startup: aggregated counters (active, per week/month, ready to test, invited/accepted), answer distribution for the question, recent anonymized answers and campaigns with aggregated statistics. Participants' contact details are not returned.

tools.name: get_store_reviews
tools.description: Public Google Play and App Store reviews of your startup: monitoring state per store and the latest reviews (rating, text, developer response). Reviews are collected automatically via the app links.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_startup, publish_update, get_store_reviews · Private data: upload_image, create_release, request_asset_upload, complete_asset_upload, get_waitlist · Public sink: create_startup, update_startup, upload_image, publish_update, create_release, request_asset_upload, complete_asset_upload.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_startup, publish_update, get_store_reviews · Private data: upload_image, create_release, request_asset_upload, complete_asset_upload, get_waitlist · Public sink: create_startup, update_startup, upload_image, publish_update, create_release, request_asset_upload, complete_asset_upload

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_releases" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

На закрытых стадиях ссылка возвращается только для своих стартапов или где у вас открыт доступ (иначе locked=true, downloadUrl=null)."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
